description_en: Requests a file upload session and a temporary direct upload URL without creating a knowledge object or starting a build
description_zh: 申请文件上传会话及临时直传地址，不创建知识对象或启动构建
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-knowledge-object-upload --knowledge-base-id 12345678-1234-4234-8234-123456789abc --file-name policy.md --content-type text/markdown --size-bytes 1024 --content-md5 yaNM/IXZgmmMasifdgcavQ== --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateKnowledgeObjectUpload

parameters.help_en: The original file name, which is not used as the object ID
parameters.help_zh: 原始文件名，不作为对象 ID
parameters.name: file_name

parameters.help_en: The HTTP media type for the upload
parameters.help_zh: 上传 HTTP 媒体类型
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en: The size of the original file in bytes. This parameter reuses the existing maximum size limit for single-file uploads, which defaults to 100 MiB. If the size exceeds the limit, the InputTooLarge error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 原文件字节数；复用现有上传单文件配置上限，默认 100 MiB；超过返回 InputTooLarge
parameters.name: size_bytes

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded MD5 hash value of the original file
parameters.help_zh: 原文件 MD5 的 Base64 值
parameters.name: content_md5

parameters.help_en: The SHA-256 checksum of the original file
parameters.help_zh: 原文件 SHA-256 校验值
parameters.name: content_sha_256

parameters.help_en: The idempotency key for the upload request
parameters.name: client_token

Code.description_en: The business error code, which is used to determine the error type when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码；请求失败时用于判断错误类型

Data.description_en: The business data returned when the request is successful
Data.description_zh: 成功时返回的业务数据

ExpiresAt.description_en: The expiration time of the UploadUrl, represented as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The maximum validity period is 30 minutes, subject to the upper limit of the OSS signature configuration and the remaining time of the session. This field prevails
ExpiresAt.description_zh: UploadUrl 过期时间，毫秒级 Unix 时间戳；最长 30 分钟，受 OSS 签名配置上限和会话剩余时间约束，以此字段为准

additionalProperties.description_en: The HTTP headers that must be included in the direct upload request. The key is the actual header name, and the value is the header value
additionalProperties.description_zh: 直传请求必须携带的 HTTP 头；键为真实 Header 名，值为该 Header 的值

RequiredHeaders.description_en: The HTTP headers that must be included in the direct upload request. The key is the actual header name, and the value is the header value
RequiredHeaders.description_zh: 直传请求必须携带的 HTTP 头；键为真实 Header 名，值为该 Header 的值

UploadId.description_en: The identifier of the upload session to be consumed by document creation, model update, or model import tasks. This is not a KnowledgeObjectId or TaskId
UploadId.description_zh: 待文档创建、模型更新或模型导入任务消费的上传会话标识，不是 KnowledgeObjectId 或 TaskId

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时的安全错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
